# Source attribution

These Apache-2.0 modules and numeric recipes were published in Dmitrii Gluzdov's VQCC FeMoCo dataset. The module headers credit Marsyas arithmetic, Phuc Thai's parity-in-top-wire normalization idea, and the public QROM/measurement lineage. Those headers are preserved byte for byte.

This folder is the sixteen-module slice actually imported by the independently executed source build, plus its numeric coefficient and phase-angle recipes. It excludes unrelated public_inv_payload.py and other unused compiled-input helpers from the larger dataset. No input circuit is present or required.

Source: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/dmitriigluzdov/vqcc-femoco-public-factorization

Francisco Angulo de Lafuente's project recovered, independently rebuilt and fully verified this credited construction. It does not claim invention of the upstream inverse-square-root design. ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0001-1634-7063.
